correctness.rationale: For y with a fixed sign over each transition, H(y)=eta*y*abs(y)/2-y has an exact quadratic finite difference, giving Q_next-Q=±sigma2*eta*x²/2. Bounding Q in a radius-R cube gives sum x²≤4B/|sigma2*eta| over an N-transition one-sided block. The sigmoid globally has derivative at most 1/4; comparison of x_next with sigma1/2 followed by Cauchy–Schwarz proves N≤1+C_R. Choosing M_R=floor(C_R)+3 forces both signs within every M_R-state window. Stationary integration yields both measure lower bounds, including non-ergodic measures. At sigma3=0 the x-recurrence is sigmoid-only, keeps constant sign and has positive amplitude floor after two steps, making y diverge at least linearly and z at least quadratically. Exact rational coboundary tests passed; no finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: For a published model whose uncontrolled attractors are described mainly numerically, this is a uniform structural restriction on all compact recurrence: sign balance with an explicit finite-visit bound and a positive stationary-mass floor. The boundary sigma3=0 loses every bounded orbit, so cubic feedback is necessary to support any compact invariant dynamics. These statements distinguish parameter-based visual chaos from mathematical constraints on where and how recurrence can occur; they are not a parameter substitution, numerical Lyapunov scan or known finite table. The bound is conservative but supplies genuine orbit-independent quantitative information.
